Cookies Policy

1. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small files or similar technologies used by websites to remember information, support functionality, improve performance, and understand how visitors use a website.

2. How We May Use Cookies

DIOR MEDICAL may use cookies or similar technologies that are necessary for website operation, authentication, security, session management, preferences, analytics, and other approved website functions.

3. Healthcare and Patient Portal

Cookies and similar technologies used around account login, patient portal access, appointment workflows, or healthcare forms should be configured carefully to avoid unnecessary exposure of sensitive health information. Sensitive medical information should not be placed in ordinary analytics or advertising cookies unless specifically reviewed and legally permitted.

4. Third-Party Technologies

The website may use third-party services for payment processing, telemedicine, healthcare forms, appointment management, security, analytics, communications, or other functions. These services may use cookies or similar technologies according to their own policies.

5. Managing Cookies

Depending on the website configuration and applicable law, visitors may be able to accept, reject, or manage non-essential cookies through a cookie banner or browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality.

6. Analytics and Advertising

Any analytics, advertising, remarketing, or tracking technologies should be documented after the final website stack is configured. DIOR MEDICAL should not publish specific vendors or purposes that are not actually deployed.

7. Updates

This Cookies Policy may be updated when the website technology, third-party services, tracking configuration, or applicable legal requirements change.

8. Contact

Questions about cookies or privacy should be directed to DIOR MEDICAL Urgent Care using the official contact details published on the website.
